extracted.name: Portobello Mushroom Sauce
extracted.description: Mushrooms are sauteed in butter, then simmered in a port wine and cream sauce. A decadent sauce for steak that is also great for dipping French bread.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms; cook and stir until tender. Stir in port; simmer until liquid reduced by half. Stir in cream; simmer until sauce becomes a thick gravy. Stir in basil just before serving.
